title: Naruto
desc: The group holds a discussion at Moso's house and concludes that the village strategist Komei may be responsible for the Cursed Warrior.

title: Naruto
desc: Despite being informed by Moso of the mission's completion, Naruto remains skeptical and proceeds to investigate the area where the skirmish against the Cursed Warrior took place.

title: Naruto
desc: Whilst Neji, Tenten and Kakashi try to lose their pursuers, the Cursed Warrior protects Komei who was being coerced into committing seppuku.

title: Naruto
desc: Toki, who had been masquerading as the Cursed Warrior, tries to attack Moso but is impeded by his imitation jutsu. Later, the Watari ninja and Naruto's group battle.
